text: Overnight: says his bull case is busted after the futures selloff on tech earnings misses.
Concedes the 775 call was wrong; 760 is the magnet. Testing the 762.27 dark pool level again, line in the sand; a break down means trouble.
Took a 15m/30m lower-Bollinger + oversold-RSI mean-reversion long with 0DTE calls off the 762 area; reports +112% in ~90 min.
Levels stay on the chart as long as they are respected; no time limit.
Post-earnings lesson: a green after-hours print can fail; beating IV crush moved the breakeven (META needed more than a ~5.9% move).
